title: Design System: Third Roll desktop and web

display.purpose: Large setup heading. Compact and narrow layouts override its size.

title.purpose: Current play instruction above the dice.

body.purpose: Base desktop/web text. Manrope is bundled by the application.

label.purpose: Player name label and settings legends.

button.purpose: Shared buttons; roll text overrides the size to 16px.

shadows.name: welcome-die
shadows.purpose: Blurred depth under the setup pip geometry.

motion.name: die-transition
motion.value: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background .2s ease-out, box-shadow .2s ease-out

motion.name: die-arrival
motion.purpose: Unheld dice settle after a roll.

motion.name: die-rolling
motion.purpose: Only unheld dice toss while rolling.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important;
motion.purpose: Applied throughout the game under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Start game button
components.description: The actual primary start treatment. Disabled while starting or when the name is empty.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-start">Start Game<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h16m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-start { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; width: 100%; min-height: 52px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 750; background: var(--ink, #203a34); color: var(--page, #eff2ee); cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s ease-out, transform .16s ease-out; } .ds-start:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--select-ink, #284d36); } .ds-start:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-start:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #b34f2b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-start:disabled { background: var(--surface-soft, #e7ece6); color: var(--muted, #576a61); cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-start { transition: none !important; } }

components.name: Retry move button

components.name: Player name field

components.name: Opponent selector
components.description: Four pressed-state buttons from setup, not route navigation. Solo is selected in this static example.
components.html: Opponents
components.css: .ds-opponents { border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0; min-width: 0; font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #203a34); } .ds-opponents legend { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 750; padding: 0; margin-bottom: 10px; display: block; } .ds-segments { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 4px; background: var(--surface-soft, #e7ece6); padding: 4px; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-segments button { font-family: inherit; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted, #576a61); border: 0; border-radius: 7px; min-height: 40px; background: transparent; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segments button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #203a34); font-weight: 800; } .ds-segments button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--selected, #deeadb); } .ds-segments button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #b34f2b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-segments button:disabled { cursor: default; }

components.name: Dice presets

components.css: .ds-presets { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 8px; font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-presets button { font-family: inherit; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 500; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; align-items: center; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #ccd7cd); padding: 10px 4px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--muted, #576a61); cursor: pointer; } .ds-presets strong { font-size: 24px; color: var(--ink, #203a34); font-weight: 750; } .ds-presets span { font-size: 11px; } .ds-presets button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--selected, #deeadb); border-color: var(--select-ink, #284d36); color: var(--select-ink, #284d36); } .ds-presets button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--selected, #deeadb); } .ds-presets button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #b34f2b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-presets button:disabled { cursor: default; }

components.name: Held pip die
components.description: A five-pip held die with the real face grid, lift, blurred shadow, and visible Held label. Default size, not a compact viewport override.
components.html: Held
components.css: .ds-play-deck { background: var(--deck, #1e453a); color: var(--deck-ink, #f5f4e9); border-radius: var(--radius, 16px); padding: 28px; } .ds-die-slot { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-die { width: 70px; height: 70px; border: 2px solid transparent; background: #f5f4e9; color: #244033; border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px; box-shadow: 0 5px 10px #071f2145; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background .2s ease-out, box-shadow .2s ease-out; } .ds-die:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-die.ds-held { background: #cee2af; border-color: #f4f4dd; transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 8px 14px #071f2152; } .ds-die:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2a07e; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-die:disabled { cursor: default; } .ds-pip-face { display: grid; width: 100%; height: 100%; grid-template: repeat(3, 1fr) / repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10%; place-items: center; } .ds-pip { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; visibility: hidden; } .ds-pip.ds-visible { visibility: visible; } .ds-hold-label { color: #d4e7b5; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-die { transition: none !important; } }

narrative.overview:
The dice sit on an evergreen deck, with the roll button below them and the scorecard alongside. Porcelain faces and circular pips give the controls their physical character. The sampler reference comes through the grouped inputs and persistent roll control, not through imitation audio equipment.

This is a post-build record of the desktop and web redesign. The owner plays the game personally, called the previous interface old-school, plain and boring, and delegated the modern visual direction. The sampler choice was code-led. It is not a claim of public approval. This document records that implementation; it does not authorize another replacement.
keyCharacteristics: Evergreen play deck against a mineral-white shell, with graphite-green dark mode.
Clay-orange roll action and pale-green held dice and score suggestions.
Manrope text, tabular scores, and visible pip geometry.
Blurred die shadows and a lifted held state; flat surrounding panels.

rules.name: The state evidence rule
rules.body: Color accompanies an observable state. Held dice also lift and say "Held"; selected setup buttons expose pressed state; suggested scores use a marker and a filled score badge.

rules.name: The lifted die rule
rules.body: Hover moves an enabled die up 3px. Held state applies a 5px lift, a pale border, and the held label. Keep the blurred shadows; hard offset slabs are not part of this system.

dos: Do keep the roll control directly below the dice and put play before scoring when the web layout stacks.
Do show held and suggested states with text, geometry, or markers as well as color.
Do retain keyboard outlines, pending-state text, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use the current CSS theme overrides for desktop and web.
donts: Don't apply this palette to native mobile or replace its existing theme without a separate request.
Don't turn the dice into raster illustrations or substitute glyphs for pip faces.
Don't restore hard offset die shadows or give every panel a shadow.
Don't shrink all text to force large hands and multi-opponent tables into one viewport.
